events.body:
Even when we are on dark mode but when we go to login/signup page it automatically shifts to light mode. 

Steps to reproduce the issue.
Just do dark mode and then go to login/signup page it will automatically shifts to light mode and then if you come back to dashboard or some other page it will be back to dark mode
